# Third-party source

`Tyrrrz-YoutubeDownloader/` is a complete source snapshot of [Tyrrrz/YoutubeDownloader](https://github.com/Tyrrrz/YoutubeDownloader), branch `prime`, commit `7bf0016b24141fff8e5b62bf9bbca6872693f073` (retrieved 2026-10-23).

The upstream project is licensed under MIT; its original `License.txt`, README, assets, and source files are retained in the snapshot. It is an Avalonia/.NET 10 desktop application. Its desktop UI cannot run inside this project's browser/Vercel Node runtime as-is. The web UI added to Dubai PRO therefore uses the existing Node/Vercel and browser-side download interfaces, while this folder preserves the complete upstream source and attribution.
